data.title: Rehabilitation application rejected
data.summary: Muster-Rentenversicherung Nordwest rejected your application of 13 January 2025 for medical rehabilitation benefits in a letter dated 11 March 2025. You may file an objection (Widerspruch).
data.explanation: The pension insurance says your earning capacity is not significantly at risk and outpatient treatment near your home is enough (§ 10 SGB VI). If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or record it in person at the insurer. The app shows the deadline. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. If your health worsens, you can apply again at any time. Consider getting advice, for example from a pension advice centre or social association.

items.title: File objection against rejection
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or record it in person at Muster-Rentenversicherung Nordwest.
items.quote: Erheben Sie ihn binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster-Rentenversicherung Nordwest.

key_facts.label: Reason (Begründung)
key_facts.quote: Nach den vorliegenden Befunden ist Ihre Erwerbsfähigkeit nicht erheblich
